send: i=0; while [ "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" != 1 ] && [ $i -lt 900 ]; do sleep 3; i=$((i+3)); done; echo BOOTDONE=$(getprop sys.boot_completed) uptime=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime)
echo ===REFORMAT-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | grep -cE 'Format /dev|wiped and'; echo ===REFORMAT-END===

echo ===DISPLAY-BEGIN===; getprop init.svc.bootanim; getprop service.bootanim.exit; dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'ResumedActivity|mFocusedApp' | head -4; dumpsys window | grep -E 'mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp' | head -3; echo ===DISPLAY-END===
echo ===LOCKSCREEN-BEGIN===; locksettings verify --old 1234; su 0 ls -l /data/vendor/weaver; locksettings clear --old 1234; echo ===LOCKSCREEN-END===
echo ===DMESG-BEGIN===; su 0 dmesg | gzip | base64; echo ===DMESG-END===
echo ===LOGCAT-BEGIN===; su 0 logcat -d -b all | gzip | base64; echo ===LOGCAT-END===
